kind: paper fairness correction before final acceptance
issue: Not establishing the opposite defer token after repayment can bypass a newly ready head twice. The root accepted this earlier textual min draft and withdraws that clause.
counterexample: E={A1,B0}: repay B0 but clear without recording skipped A1
E={A1,B1}: priority grants B1, so A1 is skipped a second time
fix: After every real grant, record the unique other eligible head as defer, including repayment grants. No other head -> clear; ineligible/stale/cancelled token never creates an issue.
